minor.issue: Unrelated restaurants are gone, but the top 8 food items are Burger Hub plus 7 burger dishes from Spice Nation, Sushi Central and Pizza Palace. Burger Hub's own dishes (Classic Cheeseburger, Double Bacon Burger, Garden Veggie Burger) are not shown. All dishes tie at 0.65, and the stable sort keeps food.search order, which lists Burger Hub last. The list also repeats the same dish names. Suggestion: boost dishes whose restaurant matched the query (+0.1), and/or dedupe by dish name.
MART returns 'Cookies' (brand Milka) because 'milk' is a substring of the brand, at relevance 0.5. This is low-value noise.

ui_bugs.issue: NOT FIXED. A tap on '+' at max stock, on the qty number or on the stepper border still navigates to /shop/product/<id>. RCA: the wrapper <View onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true}> only affects the RN responder system. RN-web Pressable (PressResponder) also listens to the DOM 'click' event. A disabled Pressable or a plain Text/View does not stopPropagation, so the click bubbles to the card's Pressable onClick and fires onPress. The variant sheet fix works only because the sheet is now outside the card in the DOM (Modal portal sibling). Fix: wrap the price-row action area in <Pressable onPress={() => {}}> (a no-op Pressable consumes the click and stops propagation), or add onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} on web, or keep '+' enabled and clamp/no-op at max (that still leaves the number and border).

critical_code_review_comments: ShopCard.tsx line 90: onStartShouldSetResponder does not stop DOM click propagation on react-native-web, so it is not a valid guard for nested Pressables on web.
explore.tsx: setFilter('all') in module context leaves activeContext unchanged, so the UI chrome (module-head, placeholder) gets out of sync with the actual search scope.
search/__init__.py FoodSearchProvider: when everything else is <= 0.5, the relevance>0.5 filter is skipped, so for queries that only match through menus, all restaurants can still appear.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To retest the stepper: UPDATE shop_products SET status='active', deleted_at=NULL WHERE id='TEST_shpprd_single'; UPDATE shop_variants SET is_active=true, stock_qty=3 WHERE id='TEST_shpprd_single_v'. Open /api/app-preview/shop/category/automobile, tap shop-sub-pieces-accessoires-moto, tap shop-add-TEST_shpprd_single, then '+' twice. At qty 3, tap the plus, the value and the border. Re-archive afterwards. The Expo web bundle is /app/mobile/dist, which needs a rebuild after src changes, so check its mtime. Set localStorage baked_access_token (from /app/memory/cust_token.sh) and baked_onboarding_done. The baked_active_context key scopes Explore. Run pytest with -n 0.
rca of the issue: Stepper navigation: react-native-web's Pressable handles the native DOM click in addition to responder events. A disabled '+' (or a non-pressable child) does not call stopPropagation, so the click reaches the ancestor card Pressable, whose onClick calls onPress and runs router.push('/shop/product/<id>'). The View responder capture added as the fix only prevents responder grant and does not stop the click. Repro: qty == stock, then click shop-qty-<id>-plus, or click shop-qty-<id>-value. Mitigation: intercept with a no-op Pressable or stopPropagation on the stepper container.
